title: Come back later: transcript and Claude session resume after a restart
gate: npm run turn:live -- --resume (owner-run: needs the owner's Barkpark login, the enrolled Mac, and a person to restart npm run host). Record: parity/live/resume.json.
evidence: scripts/turn-live.mjs --resume: gives the bot a code made up for the run, the host program is stopped and started, a fresh page shows the conversation again (9 + 9 bubbles), and the bot gives the code back (2026-11-12, restart within 5 s). The transcript is Barkpark's stored rows (asked for from 0, #35); the memory is Claude's own session, which the host resumes by provider_session_id. Not covered: a restart of the Mac itself, and a restart in the middle of a reply.
